statements.quote: Other services revenues pertain to our data center operations for which we earned $524,759 in revenue from our data center operation for the year ended September 30, 2022, which is an increase of $84,287, or 19% as compared to $440,472 for the year ended September 30, 2021.
statements.notes: Stated as data-center revenue, so recorded per the data-center revenue rule.
